authority: apostila-cga-2026; adversarial review round 3, gaps S1 and S3 through S8
method: every finding re-counted against the corpus before acting; the 43 existing forbidden variants checked for occurrences
reason: A fixed legal expression that asserts the opposite of the concept it matched, three collocations the 50 % rule required and did not get, one forbidden variant that blocks a correct occurrence, and seven that block nothing.

operations.why: `sem prejuízo de X` is fixed legal Portuguese meaning X CONTINUES to apply, so matching an absence marker makes the normalised output assert the opposite of the source — in CVM 175 regulatory text, eight times. Exactly the `à medida que` class that precision-amendment-01 blocked on quantity.measure. I read these during the sweep, recorded them as a borderline idiom, accepted them, and then reported 31 of 31 correct. 8/31 is 26 %, so the rule says keep the form and forbid the phrase.

The concept is the relation between yields and maturities. A bell curve is a distribution, a credit curve plots spreads rather than yields, and the convexity graph plots price against rate. 4 of 15, under the threshold, so the form stays.
`os Hedge Funds são considerados opções com alto risco` is the everyday `alternative`. The second half of the 50 % rule — forbid the wrong collocations — had missed this one.

The 50 % rule says demote AND restore, and only the restore half was done here. `os fluxos de pagamentos de juros e principal de um título do Tesouro` (STRIPS) and `a mudança do principal (correção pelo CPI)` (TIPS) went silent because `valor principal` does not cover them.

`registro` was at review on BOTH concepts that claim it, so the surface was unreachable — the same structural defect as `spread de rendimento`, which round 2 fixed and this pair did not inherit. artifact.record carries `domains: [software, data]` and means a stored data item; in a CGA corpus `registro` is registration with the supervisor every time. Renaming rather than removing because a preferred label cannot be deleted, and `registro de banco de dados` was already an automatic form of this concept.
Held at review only by the collision withdrawn above.
Three occurrences of `estrutura de gerenciamento de capital em instituições financeiras`, which the registered `capital regulatório`/`capital econômico` do not reach.
`decisões informadas sobre a alocação de capital` is literally this concept's definition and was lost when bare `capital` was demoted.

Blocks a correct occurrence. Of its four uses, three are `todas as ações necessárias` — already covered by the separate `ações necessárias` variant — and the fourth, `ele venderá todas as ações e deixará todo o recurso aplicado em renda fixa`, is exactly entity.share. A guard that costs a true positive and adds no coverage is worse than no guard.
Zero occurrences each. Written from imagination rather than from the corpus — the same habit that produced the translated Portuguese labels.
Zero occurrences; the plural carries the only real case.
